flawed_step: 0010-0011: The proof claims |W1| > n/2 whenever α > 0. This does not follow from |W1| ≥ (1−α)n; the hypotheses only force α ≤ 1/2, allowing α = 1/2 and |W1| = n/2.
assessment_summary: The first unjustified assertion is the strict inequality used in the base case. A non-strict inequality |W1| ≥ n/2 can be derived, but the proof as written explicitly claims the unsupported strict inequality.
